description:
Get point-in-time P/E and price-to-sales history for an Indian stock.

    Each point uses only the TTM filing that was public on that trade date. `days` accepts
    1..1825; `interval` is daily, weekly, or monthly. P/S is null where the filing lacks a
    usable top line or disclosed share count. Cache-only, mechanically computed, no verdicts.
name: get_valuation_history
